@syntax Exit
Leaves the closest loop ([For](For), [While](While) or [Repeat](Repeat)) and continues after it.

```blitzbasic
;run
For i = 1 To 10
	If i = 3 Then Exit
	Print i
Next
Print "done"
```

```text
1
2
done
```
